messages.content: Create at most two reusable medical-image reading skills from this training example. The saved answer/reason may be wrong. Return only JSON {"skills":[{"category":"general or one supplied official category","trigger":"when to apply","steps":["concrete image check","how to distinguish alternatives"]}]}. No case/patient ID, option letter, figure number, patient-specific number, copied question, or rule merely repeating the reference diagnosis. General medical findings are allowed. Skills will only be used on other patients. An empty skills list is allowed.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figure 1, which of the following options best describes the underlying cause for the mediastinal shift observed in the patient?
A) Left-sided pneumothorax leading to right mediastinal shift
B) Right-sided tension pneumothorax leading to left mediastinal shift
C) Massive right pleural effusion causing left mediastinal shift
D) Right upper lobe consolidation causing left mediastinal shift
E) Left-sided pleural effusion causing right mediastinal shift
F) Bilateral pleural effusion with no mediastinal shift
